answer.reason: The verses give several deeds of Benaiah beyond the killings his summary already names, so a short line is possible.

clauses.english: slew a lion in a pit on a snowy day
clauses.quote: slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow

clauses.english: took the spear from an Egyptian and slew him with it
clauses.quote: slew him with his own spear

clauses.english: was put over the host in Joab's room
clauses.quote: the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host

doubts: The killings of Adonijah, Joab and Shimei and the slaying of the two lionlike men of Moab are already in the summary, so they are left out.
Benaiah's command of the Cherethites and Pelethites and his place among the thirty are only offices or lists, so they are not clauses.
